title: Standardised professional UI
details: Milos now uses the shared Nisia visual system across home, learner, review, observation, calendar, form and modal screens
The Milos wordmark uses a blue i while retaining the existing Milos blue assessor identity
Cards, buttons, fields, page headers, spacing, typography and bottom sheets are standardised for a cleaner professional appearance
The weekday calendar keeps the same compact scheduling behaviour but now matches the rest of the interface
The full-screen AC video observation remains full-screen and keeps its existing recording workflow
